name: Iden Versio's TIE/ln space superiority starfighter
wookieepedia_title: Iden Versio's TIE/ln space superiority starfighter
description: During the Galactic Civil War, Commander Iden Versio of Inferno Squad utilized a specialized TIE/ln space superiority starfighter with upgraded weapons and Inferno Squad markings. Versio used the TIE fighter during the attack on Fondor.
